title: Lucid Evolution 2.0 - Blueprint & Enhanced Plutus Schema

ms.promise: Implement core data schema structures using Effect Schema.
ms.criteria:
Core schema structures must support the following Plutus data types:
- Integer
- ByteString
- List (including nested lists)
- Map
- Constr (data with constructors)
Utility functions (e.g., encoding and decoding) must leverage Effect Schema for:
- Compile-time type safety validation of Plutus Data.
- Runtime type parsing to ensure Plutus data integrity during execution.
- All core operations must pass comprehensive tests for roundtrip encoding and decoding.
ms.report:
This first milestone of Lucid Evolution 2.0 (Blueprint & Enhanced Plutus Schema) is focused on implementing the core data schema structures using *Effect Schema* to support Plutus data types. 
Summary Report
This report summarizes the design, implementation, testing, and documentation efforts aimed at providing a flexible, type-safe infrastructure for handling complex Cardano data types.
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/project-close-out-reports/blob/main/f13-lucid-evolution-closeout-report/Milestone%201/Milestone%201%20-%20Summary%20Report/main.pdf
Test Report 
This document presents the results of rigorous unit and schema-based tests executed to verify the implementation of Lucid Evolution’s core data schema structures and utility functions using Effect Schema. The tests cover all Plutus primitive data types (*`Integer`*, *`ByteString`*, *`List`*, *`Map`*, *`Constr`*), encoding/decoding utilities, and schema combinators, demonstrating both compile-time safety and runtime validation., ensuring the reliability and functionality of the implementation.
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/project-close-out-reports/blob/main/f13-lucid-evolution-closeout-report/Milestone%201/Milestone%201%20-%20Validation%20Report/main.pdf

- Plutus Address
- Plutus Value
- Plutus Credentials
- Plutus OutputReference
- Plutus CIP68 metadata

ms.criteria:
- Implement functions to correctly convert CBOR data into the following Plutus types:
 - Plutus Address
 - Plutus Value
 - Plutus Credentials
 - Plutus OutputReference
 - Plutus CIP68 Metadata
- Ensure each conversion function is capable of handling both valid and invalid CBOR inputs, with appropriate error handling for unsupported or malformed data.
- Each conversion must be tested, ensuring full coverage.
